transcript.text: I reviewed the county health guidance for the pantry this week, and here's what it requires: refrigerated food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or colder, with the temperature logged every 2 hours while the pantry is open. The guidance also requires sealed packages to display allergen labels. I have the printed guidance in my health-office binder, and these details haven't been added to the pantry draft plan yet. Our current draft only proposes a weekly temperature check, which falls short of the every-2-hours requirement, and we need to make sure our labeling procedure includes allergen labels on sealed packages.
